quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: Which Windows filesystem commonly provides file permissions and other workstation features?
explanation: NTFS is the normal Windows system-volume filesystem with ACL permissions.

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: Which filesystem is often chosen for a removable drive needing broad device compatibility?
explanation: exFAT is widely supported for removable media but lacks many NTFS features.

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: What should be identified before following an OS-specific repair procedure?
explanation: Support steps driver compatibility and available recovery paths depend on the exact OS platform; app and hardware details may also matter but do not replace it.

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: What does vendor end-of-support primarily indicate?
option_b: Security updates and vendor help may no longer be available
explanation: End of support is a lifecycle and risk boundary rather than instant hardware failure.

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: Which command shows address gateway DHCP and DNS details?
explanation: ipconfig /all displays detailed adapter configuration.
source_name: Nexus curriculum team (adapted from seed nexus-authored:Windows Command-Line Diagnostics)

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: Which command directly queries a DNS resolver?
explanation: nslookup tests name resolution against a resolver.
source_name: Nexus curriculum team (adapted from seed nexus-authored:Windows Command-Line Diagnostics)

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: A successful ping to a server proves which limited fact?
option_b: An ICMP reply returned on that path
explanation: Ping is a reachability clue and does not prove application-layer function.

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: Which command displays active connections listeners and process IDs with suitable switches?
explanation: netstat -ano shows numeric connections/listeners and owning PIDs.
source_name: Nexus curriculum team (adapted from seed nexus-authored:Windows Command-Line Diagnostics)

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: Which command refreshes Group Policy processing?
explanation: gpupdate requests a policy refresh.
source_name: Nexus curriculum team (adapted from seed nexus-authored:Windows Command-Line Diagnostics)

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: Which command checks protected Windows files without repairing them?
explanation: sfc /verifyonly checks protected files without attempting repair.

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: Why start with plain chkdsk when collecting evidence?
option_b: It performs a read-only check without immediately scheduling repair
explanation: Plain chkdsk reports filesystem state; repair switches may require downtime.

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: A managed Windows setting has not arrived. Which TWO actions form the best initial test?
option_a: Confirm the device/user scope and domain connectivity
option_b: Run gpupdate and then verify the expected setting
option_c: Run chkdsk /f because policy is stored on disk
option_d: Delete the local user profile before checking policy
explanation: Policy troubleshooting first confirms that the setting should apply and the device can reach policy services; gpupdate then provides a controlled refresh whose result can be verified.

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: How does a Windows workgroup differ from a domain?
option_a: A workgroup uses peer administration while a domain centralizes identity/policy
explanation: Workgroups are peer-to-peer; domains provide centralized management.

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: Which is a valid UNC share path?
explanation: UNC paths use two leading backslashes followed by server and share.

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: A mapped drive fails but teammates can use the share. What is a useful first comparison?
option_b: Test the UNC path and current user identity
explanation: Direct path and identity tests separate mapping issues from server outage.

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: Why not grant Everyone full control to fix a share-access ticket?
option_a: It changes both share and NTFS permissions automatically
option_b: It violates least privilege and may expose data
option_c: It prevents the share from using a UNC path
option_d: It forces every user to remap the drive
explanation: Broad permission changes create security risk and hide whether identity group membership share permission or NTFS permission caused the issue.

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: What can a metered connection setting do?
explanation: Windows can limit or defer data-heavy activity on metered connections.

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: What does a configured web proxy primarily affect?
explanation: A proxy mediates application web traffic; it is distinct from DNS and routing.

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: Which THREE checks support targeted Windows Firewall troubleshooting?
option_b: Match the affected app/service to its relevant rule or port
option_c: Review applicable logs and organization policy
option_d: Disable every firewall profile to see whether the symptom changes
option_e: Create an unrestricted inbound rule for the whole program folder
explanation: Profile rule/port context logs and policy narrow the fault while protection remains enabled; broad disablement or unrestricted rules create avoidable risk.

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: A service works on Private networks but fails after Windows labels the connection Public. What should be inspected first?
option_b: Firewall profile and the rule that applies to the service
option_d: The NTFS permissions on the application folder
explanation: Windows Firewall rules can apply to selected profiles; the change from Private to Public makes profile/rule scope the most direct evidence.

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: What command opens the Windows version dialog?
explanation: winver displays the Windows version/build dialog.

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: What command shows active network connections and listeners with numeric addresses and process IDs?
explanation: netstat -ano is the expected command.

quiz_title: A+ Windows Support Tools & Client Configuration — Module Bank
question_text: What command shows current mapped network connections in Windows?
explanation: net use lists current network mappings and connections.
